title: An optimized nucleic acid isolation protocol for virus diagnostics in cassava (Manihot esculenta Crantz.)
author: Jimenez, Leiva, et al.

steps.title: Grind leaf tissue with steel ball
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 mg of dried leaf tissue to a 2 mL microfuge tube that already contains one carbon‑steel ball, then grind the sample by shaking the tube for 3 min with a paint mixer at room temperature (RT).

steps.title: Add CTAB buffer and homogenize
steps.instruction: Open the tubes, add 1 mL of CTAB extraction buffer, vortex vigorously until a homogeneous suspension is obtained, and centrifuge the tubes for 3 min at 13 000 RPM at RT.

steps.title: Extract supernatant and heat incubation
steps.instruction: Collect 750 µL of the clear extract without disturbing the pellet and transfer it to a new 2 mL microfuge tube; incubate the tube at 65 °C in a water bath for 15 min, then place the tube on ice.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction and phase separation
steps.instruction: Add one volume (750 µL) of ice‑cold chloroform to the tube, vortex for 1 min until a continuous phase is observed, and centrifuge at 13 000 RPM for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Precipitate nucleic acids with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 1.5 mL microfuge tube, add one volume of ice‑cold isopropanol (750 µL), mix gently by inverting the tube several times, and incubate at –20 °C for at least 30 min. (The protocol may be stopped at this point.)

steps.title: Pellet nucleic acids by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 13 000 RPM for 15 min at 4 °C, then quickly discard as much supernatant as possible by inverting the tube once, taking care that the pellet remains at the bottom.

steps.title: Ethanol wash and dry pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 500 µL of 70 % ice‑cold ethanol, centrifuge at 13 000 RPM for 5 min, discard the ethanol by inverting the tube once, and air‑dry the pellet on the bench for at least 15 min.

steps.title: Resuspend and assess nucleic acid quality
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 50 µL of nuclease‑free water, then determine the quality and concentration using a Nanodrop® spectrophotometer followed by agarose‑gel electrophoresis.
